title: Ordinary finite evaluation of a section-normalized system pullback compositor
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbb Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes $X,Y,Z$ and morphisms $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $o$ and $c$ be simultaneous operations and section-normalized compositors [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Use the ordinary strict coefficient-system module categories and exact evaluation $e_{W,n}$ [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], the ordinary sequence inverse images $F_h$, and ordinary intrinsic finite pullbacks $p_{h,n}$ with compositor $a_{f,g,n}$ [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square]. For a morphism $h:V\to W$, let $q_{h,n}:F_h e_{V,n}\simeq e_{W,n}p_{h,n}$ be the inverse of pullbackTensorSequenceInverseEvaluation followed by the whiskered unit-normalized pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. For every $n\ge0$ and ordinary module sheaf $M$ on the sequence site of $Z$, the forward ordinary square is $e_{X,n}(c.ordinaryPull_{f,g,M});q_{f,n,F_g M};p_{f,n}(q_{g,n,M})=q_{fg,n,M};a_{f,g,n,e_{Z,n}M}$. This statement is entirely in ordinary module-sheaf categories; it has no complex, derived-object or localization quantifier.

proof.text: The inverse of the displayed evaluation comparison is the mate of pullbackTensorSequenceDirectEvaluation under the sequence and intrinsic adjunctions. Apply the specified inverse-evaluation Hom formula and the unit formula characterizing pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic; cancel the finite comparison with its inverse. This is implemented by evaluation_mate and ordinary_evaluation_mate.

Use the proved unrestricted finite_comp_mate helper of AmbientAdjunctionCompositorNormalization to identify the intrinsic compositor conjugate in fixed-scalar coordinates. The section realization is bijective, natural in module maps and compatible with restriction. Its normalized direct-image comparison therefore shows that this conjugate acts on every section by restriction along the canonical base-change composition isomorphism. No finite-type or ground-field assumption is used by these ordinary helpers.

The three direct-image/evaluation comparisons are identity maps on underlying sections by their unique specifications. Combined with c.sections and the intrinsic section formula, this proves that direct evaluation respects the two direct-image compositors. Use c.conjugate to identify the system direct compositor with the conjugate of c.ordinaryPull.

Apply the injective Mathlib mate correspondence to the two inverse-evaluation pastings. mateEquiv_hcomp and the two conjugate/mate vertical-pasting identities turn their equality into the direct-image equation just proved. Evaluate at M and cancel the inverse evaluation isomorphisms to obtain the displayed forward square. This gives a direct proof of the ordinary evaluation step without invoking ordinaryCompositionEvaluation. Every calculation uses arbitrary sections, so includes n=0, zero modules and identity maps.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinarySystemPullbackCompositorEvaluation
    (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (n : ℕ)
    (M : coefficientSequenceModules l E Z) :
    (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).map ((c.ordinaryPull f g).hom.app M) ≫
      ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverseEvaluation l E f n).symm ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n)
          (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E f n)).hom.app
            ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverse l E g).obj M) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicPullback (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f).map
        (((pullbackTensorSequenceInverseEvaluation l E g n).symm ≪≫
          Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Z n)
            (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E g n)).hom.app M) =
    ((pullbackTensorSequenceInverseEvaluation l E (f ≫ g) n).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Z n)
        (pullbackTensorLevelIntrinsic l E (f ≫ g) n)).hom.app M ≫
      (sfIntrinsicPullbackComp (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)) f g).hom.app
        ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Z n).obj M)
